scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/extension-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/extension-host run build && pnpm -r --if-present --workspace-concurrency=1 run typecheck
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:extension-tooling && pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/kernel run build && pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/desktop run build && pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/personal-server run build
scripts.build:extension-tooling: pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/extension-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/extension-host run build && pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/extension-template run build
scripts.verify:extension-sdk-release: pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/extension-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/extension-sdk run verify:release
scripts.test:all: pnpm run check:version && pnpm run check:architecture && pnpm run build:all && pnpm run test:tooling && pnpm run test:cognition && pnpm run test:audio && pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/extension-sdk test && pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/extension-host test && pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/kernel test && pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/desktop test && pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/personal-server test
scripts.test:tooling: pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/repo-checks --fail-if-no-match test && pnpm --filter @glimmer-cradle/workspace-supervisor --fail-if-no-match test && node --test core/avatar/tests/*.test.mjs hosts/unity-avatar-host/tests/*.test.mjs native/tests/*.test.mjs packages/extension-sdk/tests/*.test.mjs deploy/personal-server/tests/*.test.mjs products/desktop/tests/*.test.mjs products/personal-server/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:cognition: uv run --project core/cognition --extra dev pytest -q core/cognition/tests
scripts.test:audio: uv run --project engines/audio --extra dev pytest -q engines/audio/tests
scripts.check:pr: pnpm check:encoding && pnpm check:architecture && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build
